title: Rhizomorph / Experience / Sparse Resilience
objective: Adapt the smallest safe 061D/061H route-experience layer so OTHRYS can reinforce repeatedly proven legal routes, decay/degrade them when evidence shifts, and preserve sparse resilience without learning legality or authority.
laws: Preference may choose only among predeclared legal route variants; Mycelium never invents legality.
Frequency alone never reinforces a route; correctness/integrity/authority evidence and holdout are required.
Every reinforcement has decay, degrade and retirement/retraction behavior.
Experience observations are immutable evidence; preference state is derived and disposable.
Pareto preference must not collapse latency/resource/reuse/correctness into one opaque score.
Sparse cross-links are budgeted; morphological growth cannot become unbounded topology.
Cold/deleted adaptive state falls back safely to current metabolism/calibration defaults.
